description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values of different components of a gated attention mechanism in a language model across various layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The plot includes four lines: the blue dashed line represents the "attn_output," the green dash-dot line represents the "ffn_output," the orange dotted line represents the "attn_residual," and the red solid line represents the "ffn_residual." The "attn_output" line remains relatively flat and close to the x-axis until around layer 15, where it begins to rise sharply. The "ffn_output" line shows a gradual increase from the start, with a more pronounced rise after layer 15. The "attn_residual" line remains close to the x-axis throughout, with a slight increase after layer 15. The "ffn_residual" line follows a similar pattern to the "attn_output," with a sharp increase after layer 15. The plot does not provide specific data points for the activation values at the start and end of the x-axis, nor does it indicate any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the general patterns described.
